newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daido Hoxan president ousted amid internal strife.
newsitem.headline: Daido Hoxan president ousted amid internal strife.

text.p: Japanese industrial gas producer Daido Hoxan Inc said in a statement on Sunday that Shigeru Mizushima had been dismissed as president of the company at an extraordinary meeting of the board of directors.
Chairman Hiroshi Aoki would take over as president, the company statement said.

The company said Mizushima filed a complaint with prosecutors against Aoki and Takashi Ito, a vice president of the company, accusing them of breach of trust. The two men have denied Mizushima's accusations.
A company spokesman said Mizushima accused the two men of damaging the firm financially by purchasing a painting at an unusually high price from a corporate racketeer.
"It is deeply regrettable that Shigeru Mizushima abruptly filed the complaint without consulting an (appropriate) internal advisory body in the company," Daido Hoxan's statement said.
